name: Cilo Cybin Holdings Limited
source: Cilo Cybin Holdings Limited consolidated annual financial statements for the year ended 31 March 2026, audited by Nexia SAB&T with an unmodified opinion, consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income on page 22, downloaded from the issuer financial information page. Figures in Rand, group consolidated. Operating Expenses is the total of operating costs between gross profit and operating profit as the issuer presents them: administrative expenses 1,280,372 plus other operating expenses 28,993,979 plus the IFRS 2 share based payment and listing expense 217,480,665 plus the 2,379,216 fair value movement on biological assets (2025: 385,812 plus 11,405,858 less the 5,427,679 fair value gain plus a 3,630 other loss), so gross profit less operating expenses equals the printed operating result. Net Finance Costs is finance costs 784,991 less finance income 2,198,707, a net income position, and it reconciles operating result to profit before tax exactly (2025: 4,293,430 costs less 386,184 income). Income tax for FY2026 was not printed and is left empty because the profit before tax equals the profit for the year. Basic, diluted and headline loss per share are all 95.90 cents; earnings per share here is in Rand.

rows.label: ROE (%)
rows.derivedCellFormula: ROE (%) = Net Profit / Total Equity x 100

rows.label: ROA (%)
rows.derivedCellFormula: ROA (%) = Net Profit / Total Assets x 100

rows.label: Net Margin (%)
rows.derivedCellFormula: Net Margin (%) = Net Profit / Revenue x 100

rows.label: Operating Margin (%)
rows.derivedCellFormula: Operating Margin (%) = Operating Profit (EBIT) / Revenue x 100
